loadFailed: The values could not be read. {{message}} {{hint}}

info.gold: The party's gold. It must stay within the range shown below the field.
info.characters: Pick a character to edit. The stat bonuses are added to the character's stats from the game database; they are not the final values.
info.noNames: No game data folder was found, so names are shown as numbers.
info.variables: Game variables. Change them only if you know what they do.
info.values: All editable values found in this file.
info.moment: A SugarCube save keeps a history of moments, one for each passage played. The game resumes at the moment shown here, and your edits apply to that moment. The other moments keep their own values.
info.storyVariables: The story's variables ($name in the story) with the values the game will load. A lock marks values you cannot change here: values changed in parts during play and special values such as Map, Set or Date. Change those in the JSON editor.

ownName.actionTip: Give this entry your own name. It is kept for this game only.
ownName.label: Name for {{name}}

field.readOnlyIndex: read-only: the database index keeps a copy of this value, so changing it would break the index

bulk.triggerTip: Set every value this list shows to the same value
bulk.scope_one: Changes the {{shown}} value this list shows, on every page. One Undo takes it back.
bulk.scope_other: Changes the {{shown}} values this list shows, on every page. One Undo takes it all back.
bulk.scopeSearch_one: Changes the {{shown}} value that matches the search, on every page. One Undo takes it back.
bulk.scopeSearch_other: Changes the {{shown}} values that match the search, on every page. One Undo takes it all back.

values.detailsTip: What describes the file rather than the game (engine version, save type). Read-only: the game needs it as it is.

problem.notWhole: Use a whole number, without decimals.

errors.unknown: The change was not applied. Try again.

askAi.label: Ask AI
askAi.tip: Copy these values with a short note to paste into an AI chat
askAi.intro: I am editing a game save with SavePrism.
askAi.ask: Tell me which values to change and to what, by name. Keep each value inside its limits.

note.changedTip: This value was changed in parts during play, so the list cannot show it. Change it in the JSON editor.
note.specialTip: The game rebuilds this value with its own code. Change it in the JSON editor.
note.emptyTip: This value is empty (null or an empty list).

addEntry.title: Add {{label}}
addEntry.noMatch: No match in the game's database.
addEntry.noCatalog: No game data folder was found, so type the id.

addValue.title: Add a value
addValue.hint: It is written into the file when you save.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: It is taken out of the file when you save. Undo brings it back.

gwent.title: Gwent collection
gwent.info: The Gwent cards this save holds and its decks. Only the number of copies owned can be changed. The decks are read-only (changing them would rewrite the deck lists), and a card the save does not hold cannot be added here.
gwent.pickFolderTip: Card names and missing cards come from the game's own files.
gwent.pickFailed: No Gwent cards were found in that folder.
gwent.deckLocked: This deck is locked and holds no cards.

satisfactory.title: Inventories
satisfactory.info: Only the stack counts can be changed. 500 is the largest stack size.
satisfactory.empty: This save has no non-empty inventories.
